iid_census.rule: A is a 4-byte-aligned address inside file-backed bytes of .rdata or .data; reading 16 bytes at A: dword[1]==0, (dword[2]&0xFFFF)==0x00C0, dword[3]==0x46000000 (little-endian)

q2.population_definition: every function that pushes at least one address A which is in the 11-address IID census
